0cfa8a89db197a89ca0adcc989ffdf1d.pdf_text: To, Date:- 23th July,2025 The Vice Chancellor, National University of Study and Research in Law Ranchi Ranchi, Jharkhand Subject: Offer of Education Loan under Guruji Student Credit Card Scheme For Students of Jharkhand Respected Sir, We are pleased to offer education loan to the students of National University of Study and Research in Law Ranchi under the Jharkhand State-sponsored Education Loan Scheme, known as Guruji Student Credit Card Education Loan Scheme. Bank of India has successfully disbursed over 750 loans under this scheme to students of Jharkhand, demonstrating our commitment to supporting education in the region. We believe that this partnership will enable our students to pursue their academic goals without financial constraints. The key features of the education loan are as follows: a) Loan Amount: Upto Rs.15.00 Lakh b) Interest Rate: a) Male Students:-9.65% p.a presently b) Female Students:-9.15% p.a presently The Jharkhand government is providing interest subsidy in this loan scheme, so the effective rate shall be 4% simple interest for the students. c) Collateral Free: Education loans up to ₹15 lakh do not require any collateral security, making it easier for students to pursue their education. d) Repayment Terms: 15 years. We look forward to supporting the students of National University of Study and Research in Law Ranchi in achieving their academic goals. Thank you for considering this offer. Sincerely, Darpan Sharma Branch Manager Bank of India, NUSRL Campus Branch Enclosures: List of required documents & Process to apply. NATIONAL LAW SCHOOL OF INDIA UNIVERSITY Post Bag No.7201, Nagarbhavi, Bengaluru-560072 Karnataka, India Date: December 17, 2025 NOTIFICATION INSTRUCTIONS FOR THE ADMISSIONS COUNSELLING PROCESS These Instructions will guide you through the Admissions Counselling Process for admissions to the five-year integrated Undergraduate (“UG”) and Postgraduate (“PG”) programmes commencing in the Academic Year 2026-2027 at National Law Universities (“NLUs”) participating in the Common Law Admission Test 2026 (“CLAT 2026”). To participate actively and successfully in the Admissions Counselling Process, kindly follow the steps set out below: 1. Registration for the Admissions Counselling Process 1.1 Eligible Candidates will be invited to participate in the Admissions Counselling Process in accordance with the rank list and the admissions matrix provided by each NLU. 1.2 Eligible candidates will receive: 1.2.1 an email invitation to participate in the Admissions Counselling Process at their registered email address; 1.2.2 an SMS at their registered mobile number; and 1.2.3 an invitation on their CLAT 2026 portal; 1.3 Candidates must login to their CLAT account on the website of the Consortium of NLUs (the “Consortium”) and validate that they have been invited for counselling during each round. The Consortium shall not be responsible for any undelivered emails/SMSs. 1.4 Registrations for the Admissions Counselling Process will: Opened at 6:00 P.M, on December 17, 2025 and Closed at 10:00 P.M. on December 27, 2025 1.5 To complete their registration for the Admissions Counselling Process, candidates must pay the Counselling Registration Fee by 10.00 PM on December 27, 2025 and complete the following 2 steps: Page 1 of 10 CONSORTIUM OF NATIONAL LAW UNIVERSITIES Reg.No:DRB1/SOR/707/2018-2019. NATIONAL LAW SCHOOL OF INDIA UNIVERSITY Post Bag No.7201, Nagarbhavi, Bengaluru-560072 Karnataka, India 1.5.1 STEP 1 – Update NLU Preferences Login to your CLAT account. If you have been invited for counselling, you will see a “Update NLU Preferences” button. Click that button and update your NLU Preferences as required. 1.5.1.1 Candidates are requested to review the different programs and seat matrix by reviewing the brochures of the NLUs available on the Participating Universities page and provide the preferences carefully. 1.5.1.2 Candidates should provide a minimum of 15 preferences for UG and minimum of 5 preferences for PG. You can provide more preferences also. 1.5.1.3 Candidates will be considered for ONLY those NLUs for which they have provided the preference. Example: - If a candidate has chosen only fifteen preferences, then he/she will be considered only for allotment in those fifteen preferences and not to any other NLUs, even if vacancies are available in other NLUs though he or she might be otherwise entitled to by the merit list. 1.5.1.4 Candidates can update the preferences any number of times, until the closure of the counselling registration. 1.5.1.5 Candidates should note that they can only move up to the higher preferences and can not go down in the preferences given. 1.5.1.6 Requests for change of preferences after the last date shall not be considered / accepted. 1.5.2 STEP 2 – Make payment of counselling registration fees Complete the payment of the Counselling Registration Fee; Click the ‘Make Payment’ button; (the Make Payment button will be visible only if you have been selected for the Admissions Counselling Process). Pay the Counselling Registration Fee by 10:00 PM on December 27, 2025 as set out below: Candidates from the General Category: Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty thousand only) Candidates from the ST/ SC/ OBC/ BC/ EWS/ PWD categories are required to pay Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty thousand only) 1.5.3 Wait till you see a ‘Payment Successful’ message; Page 2 of 10 CONSORTIUM OF NATIONAL LAW UNIVERSITIES Reg.No:DRB1/SOR/707/2018-2019.
